scope: Public issue landing pages, homepage, archive and shared magazine reader

findings.problem: Two cover systems across recent and older issues
findings.resolution: One reusable portrait frame, live masthead, full uncropped artwork and month/year across issue pages, archive previews, homepage and reader.
Dark live Odia masthead on solid cream; local Baloo Bhaina 2 retained.
Removed automatic 48-degree swing; reduced landing-page perspective from 13 to 3 degrees; flat on phones and reduced-motion mode; user-triggered cover navigation uses a slide.

findings.problem: Reader cover artwork stretched to fill its container
findings.resolution: Full-composition contain sizing for every cover.

findings.problem: Older contents cards buried bylines inside article links
findings.resolution: Separate linked writer credits wherever the source article already has an identified profile; consistent read actions and touch targets.

findings.problem: Inconsistent read labels and crowded mobile homepage
findings.resolution: One primary reading label and full-width stacked phone introduction, with reading actions before the cover so readers can start without scrolling; clickable covers open the same reader.

findings.problem: Reader labels unclear or mismatched for assistive technology
findings.resolution: Odia fullscreen labels match visible labels; exit label includes visible wording; resume label explicitly says to continue from the previous position.

validation.reader_checks: keyboard, cover, full contents, jump, text size, theme, exit focus, resume, reduced motion
validation.source_order_and_credits: compared against pre-change Git version; unchanged
validation.artwork: original assets unchanged; existing asset checksum checks pass

remaining_opportunities: 15 older source entries lack an existing identified writer-profile link (including dated notices and children’s writing). Confirm identities before adding profiles.
Validate with actual VoiceOver/Safari and disabled readers; this audit used Chromium viewport and keyboard checks, not a full accessibility certification.

guidance.color: Minimum contrast standards: Maintain 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text or icons.
guidance.accessibility: Prefer outline over other properties for focus rings; native links and dialog retained; target sizes and focus return checked.
